text_en: The sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
text_cn: 依撒加尔的儿子：托拉、普瓦、雅叔布和史默龙四人。

text_en: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their ancestral houses, namely of Tola, mighty warriors of their generations, their number in the days of David being twenty-two thousand six hundred.
text_cn: 托拉的子孙：乌齐、勒法雅、耶黎耳、雅赫买、依贝散和舍慕耳，都是托拉家族的族长，英勇的战士；在达味时代，依他们的家系，人数有二万二千六百。

text_en: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. And the sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five, all of them chiefs;
text_cn: 乌齐的儿子依次辣希雅；依次辣希雅的儿子：米加耳、敖巴狄雅、约厄耳和依史雅······五人，都是族长。

text_en: and along with them, by their generations, according to their ancestral houses, were units of the fighting force, thirty-six thousand, for they had many wives and sons.
text_cn: 按家系和家族归属于他们的，尚有三万六千出征的战士；因为他们有很多妇女和儿童。

text_en: Their kindred belonging to all the families of Issachar were in all eighty-seven thousand mighty warriors, enrolled by genealogy.
text_cn: 连他们的兄弟，即全依撒加尔支派中的英勇的战士，登记的人数，共计八万八千。

text_en: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.
text_cn: 本雅明的儿子：贝拉、贝革尔、耶狄厄耳三人。

text_en: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five, heads of ancestral houses, mighty warriors; and their enrollment by genealogies was twenty-two thousand thirty-four.
text_cn: 贝拉的儿子：厄兹朋、乌齐、乌齐耳、耶黎摩特和依黎五人，都是家族的族长；英勇的战士，按家族统计，共计二万二千三十四人。

text_en: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher;
text_cn: 贝革尔的儿子：则米辣、约阿士、厄里厄则尔、厄里约乃、敖默黎、耶勒摩特、阿彼雅、阿纳托特和阿拉默特：以上是贝革尔的儿子，

text_en: and their enrollment by genealogies, according to their generations, as heads of their ancestral houses, mighty warriors, was twenty thousand two hundred.
text_cn: 是家族的族长；英勇的战士，按家族统计共计二万二百人。

text_en: The sons of Jediael: Bilhan. And the sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.
text_cn: 耶狄厄耳的儿子彼耳汉；彼耳汉的儿子：耶乌士、本雅明、厄胡得、革纳阿纳、则堂、塔尔史士和希沙哈尔：

text_en: All these were the sons of Jediael according to the heads of their ancestral houses, mighty warriors, seventeen thousand two hundred, ready for service in war.
text_cn: 以上是耶狄厄耳的子孙，家族的族长；英勇的战士能上阵作战的，有一万七千二百人。

text_en: And Shuppim and Huppim were the sons of Ir, Hushim the son of Aher.
text_cn: 依尔的儿子：叔平和胡平；阿赫尔的儿子胡生。

text_en: The descendants of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum, the descendants of Bilhah.
text_cn: 纳斐塔里的儿子：雅赫则耳、古尼、耶则尔、沙隆：是彼耳哈的子孙。

text_en: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his Aramean concubine bore; she bore Machir the father of Gilead.
text_cn: 默纳协的儿子：马基尔，是他的一个阿兰妾给他生的；玛基尔是基肋阿得的父亲。

text_en: And Machir took a wife for Huppim and for Shuppim. The name of his sister was Maacah. And the name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.
text_cn: 玛基尔娶了妻，妻名叫玛阿加，她的姊妹名叫责罗斐哈得，她只有女儿。

text_en: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh; the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rekem.
text_cn: 玛基尔的妻子玛阿加生了一个儿子，给他起名叫培勒士；他的兄弟名叫舍勒士。舍勒士的儿子：乌蓝和勒耿。

text_en: The son of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead son of Machir, son of Manasseh.
text_cn: 乌蓝的儿子贝丹：以上是默纳协的孙子，玛基尔的儿子基肋阿得的子孙。

text_en: And his sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.
text_cn: 他的姊妹摩肋革特生依市曷得、阿彼厄则尔和玛赫拉。

text_en: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.
text_cn: 舍米达的儿子：阿希杨、舍根、里刻希和阿尼罕。

text_en: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, and Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,
text_cn: 厄弗辣因的儿子：叔特拉；叔特拉的儿子贝勒得，贝勒得的儿子塔哈特，塔哈特的儿子厄拉达，厄拉达的儿子塔哈特，

text_en: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, and Ezer and Elead. Now the people of Gath, who were born in the land, killed them, because they came down to raid their cattle.
text_cn: 塔哈特的儿子匝巴得。厄弗辣因的儿子叔特拉和厄则尔以及厄拉得，为加特的土人所杀，因为他们下去劫掠土人的牲畜。

text_en: And their father Ephraim mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.
text_cn: 他们的父亲厄弗辣因哀悼他们多日，他的兄弟们也来慰吊。

text_en: Ephraim went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son; and he named him Beriah, because disaster had befallen his house.
text_cn: 以后，他又走近了自己的妻子，她怀孕生了一个儿子，给他起名叫贝黎雅说：“我家遭过患难。”

text_en: His daughter was Sheerah, who built both Lower and Upper Beth-horon, and Uzzen-sheerah.
text_cn: 他的女儿舍厄辣建立了上下贝特曷龙和乌曾舍厄辣。

text_en: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,
text_cn: 贝黎雅的儿子勒法黑，勒法黑的儿子勒舍夫，勒舍夫的儿子特拉黑，特拉黑的儿子塔罕，

text_en: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
text_cn: 塔罕的儿子拉丹，拉丹的儿子阿米胡得，阿米胡得的儿子厄里沙玛，

text_en: Nun his son, Joshua his son.
text_cn: 厄里沙玛的儿子农，农的儿子若苏厄。

text_en: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer and its towns, Shechem and its towns, as far as Ayyah and its towns;
text_cn: 他们占据和居留的地方：贝特耳和所属村镇，往东有纳阿郎，往西有革则尔和所属村镇，舍根和所属村镇，直到阿雅和所属村镇。

text_en: also along the borders of the Manassites, Beth-shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. In these lived the sons of Joseph son of Israel.
text_cn: 在默纳协子孙手中的，有贝特商和所属村镇，塔纳客和所属村镇，默基多和所属村镇，多尔和所属村镇：以色列的儿子若瑟的子孙住在以上各地。

text_en: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, Beriah, and their sister Serah.
text_cn: 阿协尔的儿子：依默纳、依市瓦、依市伟和贝黎雅，和他们的姊妹色辣黑。

text_en: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.
text_cn: 贝黎雅的儿子：赫贝尔和玛耳基耳，后者是彼尔匝依特的父亲。

text_en: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and their sister Shua.
text_cn: 赫贝尔生雅费肋特、芍默尔、曷堂和他们的姊妹叔亚。

text_en: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the sons of Japhlet.
text_cn: 雅费肋特的儿子：帕撒客、彼默哈耳和阿市瓦特：以上是雅费肋特的儿子。

text_en: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Hubbah, and Aram.
text_cn: 他兄弟芍默尔的儿子：洛赫加、胡巴和阿兰。

text_en: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.
text_cn: 他兄弟曷堂的儿子：祚法黑、依默纳、舍肋士和阿玛耳。

text_en: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,
text_cn: 祚法黑的儿子：稣亚、哈尔乃费尔、叔阿耳、贝黎、依默辣、

text_en: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.
text_cn: 贝责尔、曷得、沙玛、史耳沙、耶特尔和贝厄辣。

text_en: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.
text_cn: 耶特尔的儿子：耶孚乃、丕斯帕和阿辣。

text_en: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.
text_cn: 乌拉的儿子：阿辣黑、哈巴耳和黎兹雅：

text_en: All of these were men of Asher, heads of ancestral houses, select mighty warriors, chief of the princes. Their number enrolled by genealogies, for service in war, was twenty-six thousand men.
text_cn: 以上全是阿协尔的子孙，家族出名的族长，英勇的战士，杰出的将领；能上阵打仗的登记人数，共计二万六千。
